product_one_liner.value: Paddle is a merchant-of-record platform for SaaS, AI, app and other digital-product businesses that manages global payments, subscriptions, billing, tax and regulatory compliance.

eng_blog.notes: George Wilson, Head of Engineering, explains Go microservice architecture; Michael Woodward, Senior Software Engineer, explains webhook infrastructure and scaling.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live posting: Senior AI Engineer (GTM), building AI systems within the Data & AI team; not an AI-sales role.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed developer AI documentation, engineering articles, fraud/security material and subprocessor disclosures; no underlying model or model provider was identified for Paddle’s product. Compatible AI clients and documentation hosting are not treated as its model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims include SOC 2 Type 2, GDPR compliance and PCI DSS SAQ A compliance for web transactions; GDPR is a compliance claim rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced July 17, 2025; growth financing from CIBC Innovation Banking, rather than a new equity series.

raised_18mo.notes: The July 17, 2025 debt financing falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: Announced October 20, 2026: Paddle AI Toolkit, enabling developers to set up, test and manage billing from AI tools.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Dave Wileman joined as VP Sales International in August 2026, within the November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Paddle’s Marketing Automation Specialist posting explicitly identifies its CRM as Salesforce and marketing automation platform as HubSpot.
